item.title: What I watch after a deploy
item.description: A small Datadog query, a personal alert and a link back to the exact window can answer a question raised by a change.

item.title: When a failed scan looks like a closed job
item.description: A missing vacancy can mean the employer closed it or the scanner stopped early. TechJobsNL needs enough evidence to tell the difference.

item.title: Why a folded bullet lost its place in Obsidian
item.description: Roamer drew an outline guide in the right place until someone folded the item. The fix came from measuring the second render.
